version_policy.major: incompatible PGX, database, or core tool-contract change
version_policy.minor: backward-compatible capability or substantial workflow addition
version_policy.patch: backward-compatible correction, clarification, or release hardening

identity_policy.immutable_release_identity: release_id UUID stored inside the artifact
identity_policy.byte_identity: SHA-256 of the delivered ZIP, reported at handoff
identity_policy.same_version_rebuilds: forbidden after delivery; change any byte only under a new version and release_id
